FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE KARANDENIYA PRADESHIYASABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1)(a) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of member of Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of death ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna, the recognized political party to whichRanjith Donald Ranaweera the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(1)(a) of the aforesaid Ordinance,to decide upon the member of that No. 05 Magala in Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party and is notdisqualified under Section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared selectedas a member within a period of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision to nominateBodiya Baduge Lalith Rathnakumara Gamini Perera to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I, Malawenna Godage Lalith Ananda, returning officer of the Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha,acting in terms of Section 66A(1)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare thatBodiya Baduge Lalith Rathnakumara Gamini Perera was selected as the member of the Ward No. 05 Magala of KarandeniyaPradeshiya Sabha.
M. G. LALITH ANANDA,Returning Officer,Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha.
Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
